name: canada-home-energy-rebates
title: Canadian home energy rebate programs
description: Federal, provincial, territorial, utility and municipal home energy rebates, grants, loans and tax credits in Canada. Snapshot 2026-10-25: 181 program records. 135 current (124 open, 4 closing soon, 5 waitlist, 2 upcoming) and 46 closed. Published by RebateHub.ca, an independent Ontario business that is not a government site.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable identifier. Our program page is /rebates/{id}.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Program name in English, as the administrator writes it.

fields.name: shortName
fields.description: Common short name or acronym, if there is one.

fields.name: administrator
fields.description: The government body, agency or utility that runs the program.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Level of government: federal, provincial, utility, municipal.

fields.name: jurisdictions
fields.description: Province or territory codes it covers. CA means Canada-wide.

fields.name: regions
fields.description: Cities or areas it is limited to, if any.

fields.name: status
fields.description: One of open, closing-soon, waitlist, upcoming, closed.

fields.name: categories
fields.description: Upgrades it pays for, such as heat-pumps or insulation.

fields.name: audience
fields.description: Who can apply: homeowners, landlords, renters, low-income, businesses, new-builds.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: One-sentence plain-language summary.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Longer plain-language description.

fields.name: maxAmount
fields.description: Largest amount in Canadian dollars across its tiers. Empty when there is no single maximum.

fields.name: amountDisplay
fields.description: The amount in words, as shown on our pages.

fields.name: fundingType
fields.description: Kind of support: rebate, grant, loan, interest-free-loan, tax-credit, free-upgrade, point-of-sale-discount.

fields.name: incentives
fields.description: Each upgrade and what it pays. In the CSV, each item is written as “measure: amount”.

fields.name: eligibility
fields.description: The main eligibility rules.

fields.name: howToApply
fields.description: Application steps, in order.

fields.name: requiresAudit
fields.description: Whether an energy assessment is required. Empty when the program doesn’t say.

fields.name: requiresPreapproval
fields.description: Whether you must be approved or registered before buying or installing. Empty when it varies by upgrade or the program doesn’t say.

fields.name: incomeTested
fields.description: Whether the program has an income limit.

fields.name: stackableWith
fields.description: Ids of programs its administrator says it can be combined with. Our totals only add programs recorded as combining.

fields.name: stackableWithLevels
fields.description: Levels of government (e.g. provincial) whose programs it says it can be combined with, when it says so in general terms.

fields.name: excludesWith
fields.description: Ids of programs that can’t pay for the same upgrade as this one. Only the larger is counted in our totals.

fields.name: stackingGroup
fields.description: Programs sharing this group can’t both pay for the same upgrade (e.g. one Hydro-Québec or Québec-government grant per heat pump).

fields.name: deadline
fields.description: Official deadline (YYYY-MM-DD), if one is published.

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD), if one is published.

fields.name: officialUrl
fields.description: The administrator’s program page, where you apply.

fields.name: sourceUrls
fields.description: Every official source we used for the record.

fields.name: lastVerified
fields.description: Date we last checked the record against official sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Our confidence in the record: high, medium or low. See the methodology page.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Guidance and caveats for readers.

fields.name: homeTypes
fields.description: Set only when a program is limited to a kind of home (house or condo).

fields.name: heatingFuels
fields.description: Set only when a program is limited to homes heated by these fuels, e.g. a gas utility's offer to its own customers.

fields.name: url
fields.description: Our page for the program.
